;-----------------------------------------
;---------------"DAINGY"------------------
;------------------by---------------------
;------------Cryss/Razzlers---------------
;-----------------------------------------
;---3rd-place-in-512-bytes-inrto-compo----
;------------------on---------------------
;--------------demo-party-----------------
;-----------------------------------------
;--------CHAOS-CONSTRUCTIONS'999----------
;-----------------------------------------

tenbuf  EQU   #fa00
chunks  EQU   #7600
sin     EQU   #7900
        ORG   #6200

decrun  LD    DE,line
        LD    A,32
d1      LD    HL,linep1
        LD    BC,linep2-linep1
        LDIR
        DEC   A
        JR    NZ,d1
        LDI
        LD    B,32
        CALL  raspch
        CALL  raspch
        INC   HL
        DJNZ  $-7
        EX    DE,HL
        XOR   A
        CALL  fill2

;-----CO3ДAHИE HEKOTOPOГO ПOДOБИЯ CИHУCA
        LD    L,C
        INC   A
        LD    C,6
msin2b  EX    AF,AF
        LD    A,C
        ADD   A,7
        LD    B,A
        EX    AF,AF
msin2a  LD    (HL),A
        LD    (DE),A
        INC   L
        DEC   E
        ADD   A,C
        BIT   6,L
        JR    NZ,makstr
        DJNZ  msin2a
        DEC   C
        JR    msin2b

makstr  LD    IX,string
        LD    DE,#8000
ff1     LD    L,(IX)
        INC   IX
        LD    BC,#3d00
        LD    H,C
        ADD   HL,HL
        ADD   HL,BC
        EX    DE,HL
        LD    B,8
ff3     PUSH  BC
        PUSH  HL
        EX    DE,HL
        LD    A,(HL)
        RRCA
        OR    (HL)
        EX    DE,HL
        INC   DE
        LD    B,8
ff2     RLCA
        LD    C,0
        JR    NC,$+4
        LD    C,15
        LD    (HL),C
        INC   H
        LD    (HL),C
        INC   L
        LD    (HL),C
        DEC   H
        LD    (HL),C
        INC   L
        DJNZ  ff2
        POP   HL
        INC   H
        INC   H
        POP   BC
        DJNZ  ff3
        LD    DE,#f010
        ADD   HL,DE
        EX    DE,HL
        INC   E
        DEC   E
        JR    NZ,ff1

        OUT   (#fe),A
        CALL  fill

start   PUSH  BC
        CALL  wave
ugol    LD    A,(kx+1)
        ADD   A,#97-#f0
        LD    E,A
        CALL  takesin
        LD    C,A
        LD    A,E
        RLCA
        RLCA
        AND   #7f
        LD    L,A
        LD    D,(HL)
        LD    A,#f0
        RLD
        CPL
        LD    (HL),D
        LD    (plus+1),A
        LD    A,E
        RLCA
        ADD   A,C
        EXX
        CALL  takesin
        LD    C,A

;------ПOBOPOT ПЛOCKOCTИ------------------

kx      LD    A,#10;#f0
        INC   A
        LD    (kx+1),A
        LD    H,A
        JR    NZ,$+7
        LD    A,#c6;  ADD A,N
        LD    (zatemn),A
        EXX
        LD    DE,tenbuf
w2      PUSH  BC
        PUSH  BC
        EXX
        PUSH  HL
        PUSH  BC
        EXX
        PUSH  HL
        CALL  line
        POP   HL
        POP   BC
        ADD   HL,BC
        EXX
        POP   HL
        POP   DE
        SBC   HL,DE
        EXX
        POP   BC
        DEC   BC
        DEC   BC
        LD    A,D
        OR    A
        JR    NZ,w2

;-----CO3ДAHИE БOKOBЫX ГPAHEЙ-------------

        LD    C,15
        LD    DE,32
        LD    L,D
m3d6    LD    H,tenbuf&h
m3d4    LD    A,(HL)
        LD    B,C
        OR    A
        JR    Z,m3d1
m3d2    ADD   HL,DE
        JR    NC,m3d4
        JR    m3d5
m3d3    LD    A,(HL)
        OR    A
        JR    NZ,m3d2
m3d1    DEC   B
        JP    M,$+4
        LD    (HL),B
        ADD   HL,DE
        JR    NC,m3d3
m3d5    INC   L
        BIT   5,L
        JR    Z,m3d6

;----- 3ATEMHEHИE ------------------------

        LD    HL,tenbuf
        PUSH  HL
        LD    C,15
        LD    B,61
de3a    LD    A,(HL)
        SUB   C
        JR    NC,$+3
        XOR   A
        LD    (HL),A
        INC   HL
        DJNZ  de3a
        DEC   C
        JR    NZ,de3a-2

;------ПOЯBЛEHИE--------------------------

        LD    HL,chunks
        LD    D,H
        INC   D
swet    LD    A,64
        LD    E,A
        LD    C,64
        LDIR
zatemn  SUB   4
        JR    C,$+5
        LD    (swet+1),A

;------BЫBOД------------------------------

        HALT
        LD    B,D
        LD    A,#55+8
        XOR   10
        LD    ($-3),A
        OUT   (#fd),A
        LD    DE,#c000
        POP   HL
ch4     PUSH  DE
        LD    A,32
ch1     EX    AF,AF
        LD    A,(HL)
plus    ADD   A,0
        CP    16
        JR    C,$+5
        CPL
        AND   15
        RLCA
        RLCA
        LD    C,A
        PUSH  DE
        LD    A,(BC)
        INC   BC
        LD    (DE),A
        INC   D
        LD    A,(BC)
        INC   BC
        LD    (DE),A
        INC   D
        LD    A,(BC)
        INC   BC
        LD    (DE),A
        INC   D
        LD    A,(BC)
        LD    (DE),A
        POP   DE
        INC   E
        INC   HL
        EX    AF,AF
        DEC   A
        JR    NZ,ch1
        POP   DE
        LD    A,D
        ADD   A,4
        LD    D,A
        AND   7
        JR    NZ,ch4
        LD    A,E
        ADD   A,32
        LD    E,A
        JR    C,ch2
        LD    A,D
        SUB   8
        LD    D,A
ch2     LD    A,H
        OR    A
        JR    NZ,ch4
st1     POP   BC
        DEC   B
        JP    NZ,start
        LD    HL,10072
        EXX
        RET

takesin LD    L,A
        LD    H,sin&h
        RES   7,L
        RLCA
        LD    A,(HL)
        LD    B,0
        RET   NC
        NEG
        DEC   B
        RET

string  DEFB  #28,#8C,#C8,#E4,#CC,#CC,#3C
        DEFB  #C8,#E8,#B0,#28
        DEFB  #8C,#8C,#64,#64,#64
linep1  ADD   HL,BC
        LD    A,H
        EXX
        AND   %00011110
        RRCA
        ADD   A,#80
        LD    D,A
        ADD   HL,BC
        LD    E,H
        LD    A,(DE)
        EXX
        LD    (DE),A
        INC   DE
linep2  RET
        DEFB  0,0,#80,0,#80,#20,#A0,#20
        DEFB  #A0,#A0,#A4,#A0,#A4,#A1
        DEFB  #A5,#A1,#A5,#A5,#E5,#A5
        DEFB  #E5,#B5,#F5,#B5,#F5,#F5
        DEFB  #FD,#F5,#FD,#F7,#FF,#FF
raspch  XOR   A
        RLD
        LD    C,A
        RLCA
        RLCA
        RLCA
        RLCA
        OR    C
        JR    linep2-2
fill    LD    A,#55
        CALL  fill1
        LD    A,#57+8
fill1   OUT   (#fd),A
        LD    A,65
        LD    HL,#d800
fill2   LD    D,H
        LD    E,L
        INC   DE
        LD    (HL),A
        LD    BC,sin+#7e-chunks-64
        LDIR
        RET

wave    LD    HL,#8000
        PUSH  HL
        LD    B,16
wave1   LD    A,B
        CP    9
wave2   JR    C,klkl
        LD    C,A
        LD    A,17
        SUB   C
        INC   L
        JR    $+3
klkl    DEC   L
        XOR   (HL)
        LD    (HL),A
        INC   H
        DJNZ  wave1
        POP   HL
        INC   L
        LD    (wave+1),HL
        RET

l1      EQU   linep2-linep1*32+1
line    EQU   chunks-l1
